incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 streaming latency spike detected on eu-west streaming-proxy cluster (svc=stream-gateway-eu, metric=p99_stream_latency) — paging oncall
ingrid (oncall): I'm on it. dobuckets? any customer-visible errors? :eyes:
samir: seeing increased tail (p95->p99) starting ~3845121500, spike to ~7.2s p99 for SSE chunk delivery. many connections show long idle gaps between chunks.
lia: nope 500s not spiking. logs show repeated `write EAGAIN` from upstream to proxy for some clients. suspect slow consumer/backpressure.
kevin: adding trace link: https://traces.redwood/in/3845122001 - lots of backend processing <100ms, time spent in proxy write/flush.
marta (cust-succ): flagged two paying customers: beta-chat and docs-summarize reported UI stalls. product is seeing timeouts from browser. customers on eu-west region only so far.
ingrid (oncall): ok immediate mitigations? can we temporarily fallback to non-streaming chunked responses for affected routes?
samir: we can flip gateway flag to disable streaming for route `/v1/live` to fall back to full-response. quick toggle: `POST /admin/route-toggle {"route":"/v1/live","streaming":false}` (requires ops token).
devops: I can run that. also bumping proxy keepalive timeout + reduce max_chunk_age to force more frequent smaller writes. patch applied on a rolling basis to two nodes now.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: rolling config change started (change-id: cfg-9832). Estimated completion ~2m.
lia: while rolling, capturing netstat from one affected proxy: ```
Proto Recv-Q Send-Q Local Address Foreign Address State
tcp 0 65536 10.0.2.14:443 10.1.23.45:52344 ESTABLISHED
tcp 100 0 10.0.2.14:443 10.1.23.45:52344 ESTABLISHED (send buffer stalled)
```
kevin: also seeing `client_recv_window` metric on kubernetes pods drop to 0 for some sessions -> client-side backpressure (browsers not reading). Could be slow mobile clients or long-poll connections.
marta (cust-succ): I've messaged affected customers with temporary workaround: refresh or retry; asking for timeline and whether they'll need credits.
samir: suggestion: enable server-side periodic heartbeat chunk ("--heartbeat--") every 5s to keep proxy write buffers alive. We can inject at gateway level as a short-term patch.
ingrid (oncall): agree. priority order: 1) toggle route streaming off for most impacted customer routes, 2) enable heartbeat injection, 3) continue rollback/patch review. Who will do heartbeat?
devops: I can create a hotfix to gateway lua filter to emit heartbeats; pushing to canary now. watching CPU/memory.
incident-bot: metrics: p99_stream_latency now dropping from 7.2s -> 2.6s after keepalive + chunk-size tweak on two nodes. still noisy but improving. :thumbsup:
kevin: capturing a small trace of an affected session (snip): ```
[proxy] write start 0.000s
[proxy] write blocked 2.300s (EAGAIN)
[proxy] write resume 2.350s
[client] ack recv 2.355s
```
lia: logs show a few long-lived websocket clients with huge pending write queues; prob with client-side consumers. We should add per-connection queue caps so one slow client doesn't block proxy flushers.
ingrid (oncall): can we apply per-conn caps without a full deploy? maybe runtime config?
samir: we have runtime flag `max_pending_chunks_per_conn` that can be reduced from 64->8 via remote config. I've proposed cfg-9840. Can push now.
devops: applied `max_pending_chunks_per_conn=8` on canary cluster. monitor.
incident-bot: watch: p95 latency falling to ~600ms, p99 ~1.1s on canary. still seeing a tail in some sessions.
marta (cust-succ): customers updated. one customer will accept the fallback route until full fix. they asked for ETA ~1h.
ingrid (oncall): summarizing for handoff: root cause likely slow-consumer client backpressure + proxy write buffer behavior (EAGAIN). Mitigations in flight: keepalive/keepalive-tweak, reduced chunk age, heartbeat injection, per-conn pending-chunk cap, and temporary route fallback for critical customers. Impact: degraded p99 in eu-west for streaming endpoints; some customers experienced UI stalls/timeouts; no backend model failures. Next steps: monitor 30m, prepare permanent fix to stream flush logic and add queue isolation per client.
kevin: I'll open a follow-up ticket (ENG-STREAM-612) with traces + logs.
lia: generating postmortem template now and capturing repro steps.
ingrid (oncall): handing off to next oncall @samir at 3845122068 — please continue monitoring and coordinate with devops for full rollout. :wave:
samir: taking it. will update if anything regresses. :eyes:
incident-bot: auto-note: incident paged at 3845122001, handoff at 3845122068, severity: Sev3 (customer-impacting, mitigation available).
